rationale: The plan correctly treats the STAR/featureCounts matrix as integer gene-level counts entering DESeqDataSetFromMatrix directly, explicitly rules out tximport and length correction, and fits ~condition with control releveled as reference and a named (condition, treated, control) contrast for an unpaired single-batch 3-vs-3 design. QC (blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, sample distances, library sizes, colored by condition with a stated no-silent-exclusion outlier policy) precedes the test; the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified, normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the models, BH at alpha 0.05 via results() with independent filtering, and apeglm shrinkage is applied with unshrunken and shrunken LFCs kept side by side. Power at n=3 is stated explicitly and enrichment is correctly omitted. The only reservation is the edgeR-intersection rule as the high-confidence set, which is defensible but further reduces already low power and is not required by the design; the report specification is otherwise complete with versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, diagnostics, and caveats.
